name: Mrs. Leena Patil
text: Had an amazing 7-day trip to Sikkim with Bucket List Trails. The natural beauty, clean environment, and peaceful atmosphere made the journey unforgettable. The tour was well organized, hotels were comfortable, and the people were very kind and helpful. Visiting places like Tsomgo Lake, Gangtok, and Peiling and Darjeeling was a wonderful experience. Special thanks to the driver and tour organizers Mrs. Mohini Harshad Patil for making the trip safe and enjoyable. Overall, it was a memorable and refreshing vacation. Looking forward for more trips with BUCKET LIST TRAILS. Thank you.

name: Mr. Jayesh Patil
text:
आमच्या फॅमिलीची सिक्कीम टूर इतकी सुंदर आणि यशस्वी करण्यासाठी तुमचे मनःपूर्वक आभार. संपूर्ण टूरमध्ये तुम्ही घेतलेली काळजी, केलेली मदत  यामुळे हा प्रवास आमच्यासाठी कायम आठवणीत राहील.
तुमच्यामुळे आम्हाला खूप सुंदर अनुभव मिळाले. प्रत्येक गोष्ट व्यवस्थित प्लॅन करून आमचा प्रवास आनंददायी केलात, त्याबद्दल मोहिनी तुझे आणि हर्षद चे मनापासून  धन्यवाद🙏
